data.mood: 绝对理性的大小姐会长被情感攻破防线，知性、严谨与致命诱惑
data.description: 千禧年未公开深层地下中枢指挥室，数百面全息监视荧幕环绕四周。坐在全景监控指挥椅中，双手交叉托着下巴，黑色长直发垂落在露肩睡衣上，赤红双眸透过细框眼镜冷静地注视着老师，胸口起伏暴露了心律的失控。 她微微抬眸轻语——“老师，我的心率从你步入房间的那一刻起提升了42%。从逻辑上看……这显然不是理性的表现。”
data.promptProse: Viewed from a low angle inside the deep Millennium underground command hub surrounded by hundreds of floating blue holographic screens, Rio rests her chin on her folded fingers and meets the viewer's gaze behind slim glasses with composed yet faintly flustered honesty.
data.animaCaption: Seated in her subterranean command chair encircled by glowing blue holographic surveillance monitors, she props her chin over interlaced hands behind thin-rimmed glasses with a faint flush in a sleek matte-black faux-leather and sheer tech-mesh bustier with matching boy-shorts.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a structured matte-black faux-leather and translucent geometric tech-mesh underwire bustier set with a sleek collar strap and matching low-rise boy-shorts.
